user.title: Connect to Aperture
user.description: Enter your gateway URL, such as https://aperture.example.ts.net. Home Assistant must be able to reach it and have model and connector grants. Leave the credential empty when using Tailscale identity. After setup, use Add service to create conversation and AI task entities.

reconfigure.title: Aperture connection
reconfigure.description: Update connection settings for this gateway. Leave the credential field unchanged to preserve its saved value; enter an empty value to clear it.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Aperture
reauth_confirm.description: Update your credential and check the Tailscale identity and grants used by Home Assistant.

error.invalid_url: Enter the gateway URL or its /v1 root, without credentials or query parameters.
error.access_denied: Access denied. Check the grants for Home Assistant's Tailscale identity.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read Aperture's model catalog. Check the URL, network connection, and TLS certificate.

abort.wrong_gateway: This URL identifies a different gateway. Add it as another integration.

options.title: Aperture conversation agent
options.description: Choose a model and the API format its Aperture provider supports. Select Aperture MCP tools to give Assist remote tools. Select Device control as well if you want home control. Leave temperature unset unless the model supports it.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The gateway must be connected before configuring an agent.

options.title: Aperture AI task
options.description: Choose a model with the API format, image input, and structured output capabilities your tasks need. Leave temperature unset unless the model supports it.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The gateway must be connected before configuring an AI task.
